bio_en: Onnik Torosian, known as Nevruz, was born in the Surb Khach quarter of Rodosto on the Sea of Marmara into a prosperous family and worked as a tobacco grower until the Hamidian tobacco monopoly ruined the trade. When the ARF organised in Rodosto in 1894 he formed dozens of cells in two quarters, kissing the party's seal as he took his oath. In 1895, working as a ragged cook in Romania, he attracted the attention of the propagandists Vramian and Varandian and begged to be sent to fight. A giant of a man, he led one of the bands that crossed into Ottoman Armenia in September 1903 and was killed in the Basen clashes.
